name: cornucopia
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: A cornucopia is a basket of fruit. It was a common mark of the goddesses of fecundity and of the Otherworld. Fecund goddess figures carried such a basket. A cross-reference sends the reader to the Deae Matres for more detail.

okr.objective: The cornucopia marks goddesses of fecundity and of the Otherworld.
